body:
## Pull request overview

This PR addresses multiple CI failures on `main` by fixing new `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` rule violations, stabilizing kanban test mocks for touch drag-and-drop, and ensuring the console performance-budget workflow builds workspace packages before compiling the console.

**Changes:**
- Refactor several hooks to avoid ref mutations during render by moving `.current` assignments into `useEffect`.
- Fix kanban test crashes by adding missing `TouchSensor` mocks for `@dnd-kit/core`.
- Update the `performance-budget` GitHub workflow to build workspace packages prior to `@object-ui/console build:server`, and adjust `usePerformance` render counting behavior + tests.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/react/src/hooks/usePerformanceBudget.ts | Moves `onViolationRef.current` assignment into `useEffect` to satisfy new lint rules. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/usePerformance.ts | Changes `renderCount` tracking to increment via `markRenderStart` stop callback; updates returned metrics shape. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts | Moves `shortcutsRef.current` assignment into `useEffect`. |
| packages/react/src/hooks/useFocusManagement.ts | Moves `onFocusChangeRef.current` assignment into `useEffect`. |
| packages/react/src/__tests__/usePerformance.test.ts | Updates tests to match the new `renderCount` behavior. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/view-states.test.tsx | Adds missing `TouchSensor` mock. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/performance-benchmark.test.tsx | Adds missing `TouchSensor` mock in both `vi.mock` and `vi.doMock` paths. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/dnd-undo-integration.test.tsx | Adds missing `TouchSensor` mock. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/accessibility.test.tsx | Adds missing `TouchSensor` mock. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/KanbanEnhanced.test.tsx | Adds missing `TouchSensor` mock. |
| packages/collaboration/src/usePresence.ts | Moves `currentUserRef` and `sendPresenceRef` updates into `useEffect`. |
| packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx | Reorders callbacks to avoid used-before-declared and fixes dependency list. |
| eslint.config.js | Downgrades new React Compiler-style rules to warnings to unblock CI. |
| .github/workflows/performance-budget.yml | Builds workspace packages before running the console server build. |
</details>

`renderCount` is now incremented only when the caller invokes `markRenderStart()` and then calls its returned stop function, so it no longer represents “total render count since mount” (as the type/docs indicate) and will stay 0 unless consumers opt in. If consumers rely on `renderCount` as an actual render counter, this is a behavior break. Consider either (a) reintroducing true render counting in a lint-compliant way (e.g., updating a ref in an effect and ensuring the returned `metrics.renderCount` reflects the latest value each render), or (b) renaming the field/docs to reflect that it counts measured renders/marks, not React renders.
